ruling: corpus/00-doctrine/ARBITRATION.md S38 — amends S35 in place
summary: S35's 'no square for a place the player has not stood in' binds the map's DERIVATION and the game's own authoring surface, not the authenticity of a save file. Enforceable: one non-derived field, a map that is a pure function of it, no naming parameter or accessor, an itemised load audit. Not enforceable, and now explicitly not required: distinguishing a forged footprint from a real one. A critic may not fail a build for a forged footprint.

measured.province: 193x222 = 42846 cells at 25 m; 42 places in pois.json
measured.exhaustive_generator_sweep: 42846/42846 cells, each asserted alone AND carrying every claim an attacker can write: 0 unjustified squares, 0 out-of-sightline cells; 721 place-emissions from 721 cells (1.683%)
measured.union_law: 40/40 random footprints agree with the union of their own cells => the sweep is a proof over all 2^42846 saves
measured.pre_s38_control: 1,798,811 unjustified squares of 1,799,532 place-emissions (99.96%), from 100% of cells; 1,776,659,696 out-of-sightline cells; exit 1 on 4 of 6
measured.forgery_cost: honest 557c/980B/8p/28.09% (connected); minimum 42c/108B/42p/33.67% (NOT connected); connected tour 848c/1464B/42p/46.41%; maximal 42846c/57128B/42p/100%
measured.contiguity_rejected: requiring a connected footprint raises the forged map from 33.67% to 46.41% of the province — the tightening makes it show MORE
measured.disclosure_bound: the map's whole vocabulary is a 25 m quantisation of pois.json, 16,110 B of plaintext naming all 42 places at float precision on the same disk
